en.title: Plugging search into the agent doesn’t solve the problem
en.caption:
Cloudflare launched a Web Search API in beta for agents and AI apps. The idea is simple: search live information on the internet through AI Gateway, instead of relying only on what the model already knows. At launch, there are 3 providers: Ceramic.ai, Exa and Linkup.

My take: this reinforces an important point. Search doesn’t solve things on its own. Plugging an API into the agent doesn’t make it execute a real task better. The value shows up when search, context, rules and measurement work together.

That’s where many companies get stuck. The agent may query external sources, but no one defines when to search, what to bring back, what it is allowed to state and how to measure accuracy.

I already solved this in a building materials store in Southern Brazil. There were 13,312 products in the ERP, 136 ways to write the unit and 245 mapped synonyms for countertop. The AI never sees the catalog: a simple search answers in milliseconds and returns 8 results to the model. With this setup, 65 out of 65 real customer questions found the right product.

Infrastructure helps. Orchestration and metrics make it work.
